title: Firefly Learning Resource Manifest v1
description: Course resource manifest owned by the Firefly Resource Manager. Pure resource inventory: IDs, paths, hashes. MUST NOT contain mastery/progress/quiz/misconception fields (enforced by Firefly validators and tests/test_learning_bridge_memory_guard.py).

course_id.description: Generated by the Firefly Resource Manager. Never by a model.

learner_id.description: Generated by Firefly once and long-term stable. Referenced here; never re-generated per course.

resource_id.description: Deterministic from sha256[:12]. Generated by the Firefly Resource Manager.

relative_path.description: Relative to the course directory. Original absolute paths MUST NOT become runtime dependencies.
